summary: implement task execution strategies prioritizing pending prs then worktrees then issues

delivery.outcome: Implement pluggable task execution strategies with default 'in_flight_first' prioritizing: 1) Pending PRs, 2) Pending local worktrees, 3) New tasks / issues. Add task_strategies module with PR/worktree detectors and strategy resolution; integrate with compile_execution_plan, cli_decide, cli_work, and autonomy_strategy defaults.

architecture.decision: Introduce src/koru/autonomy/task_strategies.py providing strategy definitions (in_flight_first, accordion_detail_to_general, worktree_first, issues_first) with find_pending_prs and find_pending_worktrees detectors. Update compile_execution_plan to prioritize pending PRs first (phase=pending_pr) and pending local worktrees second (phase=pending_worktree) before falling back to planfile_queue or whole-project discovery. Expose strategy flag on koru decide and koru work next.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit to restore previous execution plan compilation.

validation.evidence: All task execution strategy tests pass, verifying in_flight_first prioritization (PRs -> worktrees -> issues) and CLI flag integration.
The governance gate reports 0 errors from the ticket worktree.
